An unmatched [ in a link label is escaped so the link survives

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<a href=\"S\">[A;B)</a>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
